race.description: Gold Coast Turf Club Premier's Cup (G3)
race.comment: BONIFACE (5) heavily supported last start when held up badly in the straight before getting out late to finish fifth over 1800m at this track. Ready for the 2000m and jump in grade with Tommy Berry to ride. At his top now and can redeem himself here. MATUSALEM (7) has impressed in the two runs back and looking for this trip and further now. Was just over a month between runs when he wound up strongly only to peak on the run when second over 1800m here. Will go back from the draw and close strongly. SO YOU ARE (9) underrated stayer having his first run for the Baker yard. Slashing run from back in the field when fourth over 2350m in the Grafton Cup. Should be competitive in this field and expect to see him race closer. THEBUDGIESMUGLA (2) exciting stayer kept up to the mark with a 1030m trial after winning the LR Caloundra Cup at the Sunshine Coast over 2400m on July 4. Handles all conditions and will be there at the business end.
